raw.es: Sin importar dónde mires, lo único que ves son árboles muertos, cenizas y rocas. En este lugar es imposible encontrar una gota de agua. Tienes que salir de este lugar rápidamente.
raw.id: Ke mana pun mata memandang, hanya ada pohon kering, abu, dan batu. Tidak ada air. Harus keluar dari sini secepatnya.
raw.pt: Não importa para onde se olha, não há nada além de árvores secas, cinza e rochas. Esse lugar não tem a menor esperança de ver água. Você precisa sair logo daqui.
raw.th: ไม่ว่าคุณจะมองไปทางไหน ก็มีแต่ต้นไม้แห้งตาย หิน และ เถ้าถ่าน คงไม่มีหวังที่จะพบกับน้ำในที่แห่งนี้แล้ว คุณจะต้องออกจากที่นี่โดยเร็วที่สุด
raw.vi: Dù ngươi có nhìn nơi đâu vẫn chẳng có gì ngoài cây cối chết khô, tàn tro và đá tảng. Nơi này thật chẳng có hy vọng nhìn thấy nước. Ngươi phải nhanh chóng ra khỏi đây.

id: Ada banyak jalan ke luar. Sepertinya bakal segera keluar dari pegunungan, tapi ada sesuatu di depan, kehadiran musuh yang kuat.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_713_DESCRIPTION
desc: There are now a lot of paths leading out. It looks like you'll be able to escape the mountains soon, however, you can feel something ahead, the presence of a strong enemy.

raw.en: There are now a lot of paths leading out. It looks like you'll be able to escape the mountains soon, however, you can feel something ahead, the presence of a strong enemy.
raw.es: Ahora hay muchos caminos posibles. Parece que podrás escapar de las montañas pronto. Sin embargo, sientes algo delante: la presencia de un enemigo poderoso.
raw.id: Ada banyak jalan ke luar. Sepertinya bakal segera keluar dari pegunungan, tapi ada sesuatu di depan, kehadiran musuh yang kuat.
raw.pt: Tem muitos novos caminhos de saída. Parece que você poderá sair logo das montanhas, mas você pode sentir algo adiante, a presença de um inimigo poderoso.
raw.th: ตอนนี้มีเส้นทางมากมายที่นำไปสู่ทางออก ดูเหมือนว่าคุณจะหนีออกจากภูเขาได้ในไม่ช้าแล้ว อย่างไรก็ตาม คุณสัมผัสได้ถึงบางอย่างข้างหน้า ตัวตนของศัตรูที่แข็งแกร่ง
raw.vi: Lúc này có rất nhiều con đường dẫn ra. Dường như ngươi sẽ sớm có thể thoát khỏi dãy núi này, tuy nhiên, ngươi có thể cảm thấy một thứ gì đó phía trước, sự hiện diện của một kẻ thù rất mạnh.

id: Udaranya sellau kering, tapi makin susah bernapas. Setelah rehat sejenak, raungan intens bergema dari kejauhan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_714_DESCRIPTION
desc: The air is dry as always, but it's getting harder and harder to breath. After a short break, an intense roar echoes from afar.

raw.en: The air is dry as always, but it's getting harder and harder to breath. After a short break, an intense roar echoes from afar.
raw.es: Como siempre, el aire está viciado, pero cada vez es más difícil respirar. Después de un breve descanso, se escucha un fuerte rugido a lo lejos.
raw.id: Udaranya sellau kering, tapi makin susah bernapas. Setelah rehat sejenak, raungan intens bergema dari kejauhan.
raw.pt: O ar é seco como sempre, mas é cada vez mais difícil respirar. Depois de um curto intervalo, um rugido intenso ecoa na distância.
raw.th: อากาศยังแห้งเช่นเดิม แต่มันก็หายใจได้ยากขึ้นเรื่อยๆ ทุกขณะ หลังจากพักสักครู่ เสียงคำรามที่น่ากลัวก็ดังสะท้อนมาจากที่ไกลๆ
raw.vi: Không khí vẫn khô như mọi khi, nhưng càng ngày càng khó thở hơn. Sau khi nghỉ một chút, từ xa vang vọng lại một tiếng gầm dữ dội.

id: Di depan ada danau beku. Sepertinya satu-satunya jalan ke pantai adalah dengan menyeberanginya. Berhati-hatilah melangkah.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_720_DESCRIPTION
desc: Before you lies a frozen lake. It seems the only way to get to the beach on the other side is to cross over it. Be careful as you proceed forth.

raw.en: Before you lies a frozen lake. It seems the only way to get to the beach on the other side is to cross over it. Be careful as you proceed forth.
raw.es: Delante de ti hay un lago helado. Parece que la única manera de llegar a la otra orilla es cruzarlo a pie. Ten cuidado mientras lo haces.
raw.id: Di depan ada danau beku. Sepertinya satu-satunya jalan ke pantai adalah dengan menyeberanginya. Berhati-hatilah melangkah.
raw.pt: À sua frente está um lago congelado. Parece ser a única forma de chegar à praia do outro lado. Tome cuidado enquanto avança.
raw.th: เบื้องหน้าคุณเป็นทะเลสาบน้ำแข็ง ดูเหมือนว่าทางเดียวที่จะไปชายหาดอีกฝั่งได้ก็คือข้ามมันไป จงระวังขณะที่คุณก้าวย่าง
raw.vi: Trước khi ngươi nằm trên mặt hồ đóng băng. Có vẻ như cách duy nhất để đến được bãi biển phía bên kia là vượt qua nó. Hãy cẩn thận khi ngươi bắt đầu.

id: Di sini juga kering, tapi karena alasan lain selain tinggi di atas gunung. Tidak mungkin tahan berdiri di cuaca sedingin ini. Apa Lugina benar-benar menunggu di sini?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_721_DESCRIPTION
desc: It is dry here as well, but for a different reason than it was up in the mountains. It's impossible to stand still in this cold. Could Lugina really be waiting here?

raw.en: It is dry here as well, but for a different reason than it was up in the mountains. It's impossible to stand still in this cold. Could Lugina really be waiting here?
raw.es: Aquí también el clima es seco, pero por una razón diferente a la de las montañas. En este frío, es imposible quedarse quieto. ¿Lugina realmente estará aquí?
raw.id: Di sini juga kering, tapi karena alasan lain selain tinggi di atas gunung. Tidak mungkin tahan berdiri di cuaca sedingin ini. Apa Lugina benar-benar menunggu di sini?
raw.pt: Aqui também é bem seco, mas por motivos diferentes do que nas montanhas. É impossível ficar sem se mexer nesse frio. Será que o Lugina está mesmo esperando por aqui?
raw.th: อากาศที่นี่ก็แห้งเช่นกัน แต่มันก็เป็นด้วยคนละเหตุผลกับในภูเขานั่น เป็นไปไม่ได้เลยที่จะยืนเฉยๆ ในความหนาวเช่นนี้ ลูจิน่าจะรออยู่ที่นี่จริงๆ เหรอ?
raw.vi: Ở đây không khí vẫn khô, nhưng vì một lý do khác so với khi ở vùng núi. Không thể đứng yên trong giá lạnh thế này. Liệu Lugina có thực sự đang chờ ở đây?

id: Selangkah demi selangkah, danau beku terseberangi. Menengok ke belakang, baru setengah jalan. Seberapa jauh es tipisnya bertahan?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_722_DESCRIPTION
desc: Step after shaky step, you cross the surface of the frozen lake. Looking back, you realize you've made it exactly halfway. How long will the ice hold?

raw.en: Step after shaky step, you cross the surface of the frozen lake. Looking back, you realize you've made it exactly halfway. How long will the ice hold?
raw.es: Tembloroso y paso a paso, cruzas la superficie del lago helado. Miras hacia atrás y te das cuenta de que has cruzado la mitad. ¿Cuánto soportará el hielo?
raw.id: Selangkah demi selangkah, danau beku terseberangi. Menengok ke belakang, baru setengah jalan. Seberapa jauh es tipisnya bertahan?
raw.pt: Pé por pé, tremendo, você cruza a superfície do lago congelado. Olhando para trás, você percebe que está exatamente na metade do caminho. Quanto tempo o gelo vai aguentar?
raw.th: คุณได้ก้าวไปอย่างทุลักทุเล ข้ามพื้นผิวบางๆ ของทะเลสาบน้ำแข็ง เมื่อมองไปข้างหลัง คุณก็พบว่าคุณได้ผ่านไปครึ่งทางแล้ว น้ำแข็งใต้เท้านี่มันจะทนได้อีกแค่ไหนกันนะ?
raw.vi: Dấn tới với bước chân run rẩy, ngươi vượt qua bề mặt hồ đóng băng. Nhìn lại, ngươi nhận ra mình đã đi được chính xác một nửa đường.  Liệu lớp băng này sẽ giữ được bao lâu?

id: Angin dingin bertiup di danau. Mencoba mengabaikannya, suhu tiba-tiba turun secara tidak normal. Ada apa ya?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_723_DESCRIPTION
desc: A chilling wind blows across the lake. Attempting to shrug off the piercing cold, the temperature around you drops unnaturally. What could it be?

raw.en: A chilling wind blows across the lake. Attempting to shrug off the piercing cold, the temperature around you drops unnaturally. What could it be?
raw.es: Un viento gélido cruza el lago. Intentas encogerte para soportar el frío, pero la temperatura baja de una manera sobrenatural. ¿Qué podría ser?
raw.id: Angin dingin bertiup di danau. Mencoba mengabaikannya, suhu tiba-tiba turun secara tidak normal. Ada apa ya?
raw.pt: Um vendo frio sopra no lago. Tentando se desvencilhar do frio lancinante, a temperatura ao seu redor cai de forma não natural. O que será que é?
raw.th: ลมหนาวพัดผ่านทะเลสาบ คุณพยายามจะสลัดความหนาวเย็นทิ้ง แต่อุณหภูมิรอบตัวคุณกลับลดลงอย่างไม่เป็นธรรมชาติ มันเกิดอะไรขึ้นกันแน่?
raw.vi: Một cơn gió lạnh thổi qua mặt hồ. Cố gắng rũ bỏ cái lạnh xuyên thấu, nhiệt độ xung quanh ngươi tụt giảm bất thường. Đó có thể là gì?

id: Pantai sudah terlihat, akhirnya keluar dari danau es. Bergegaslah ke pantai agar tidak tergelincir.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_724_DESCRIPTION
desc: The shore is in view, you can finally get off the ice. Hurry up and get to the shore where there's no chance of slipping.

raw.en: The shore is in view, you can finally get off the ice. Hurry up and get to the shore where there's no chance of slipping.
raw.es: Tienes la costa delante de ti. Finalmente podrás salir del hielo. Apúrate y llega a la orilla, donde no hay posibilidades de resbalarse.
raw.id: Pantai sudah terlihat, akhirnya keluar dari danau es. Bergegaslah ke pantai agar tidak tergelincir.
raw.pt: Você consegue ver a margem, finalmente vai sair do gelo. Aperte o passo e chegue à margem, onde não há chance de escorregar.
raw.th: มองเห็นชายฝั่งอยู่ไม่ไกล ในที่สุดคุณก็จะพ้นจากน้ำแข็งแล้ว เร็วเข้ารีบไปขึ้นฝั่งจะได้ไม่ต้องเสี่ยงกับการลื่นอีก
raw.vi: Bờ hồ đã trong tầm nhìn, ngươi cuối cùng cũng ra được khỏi băng. Hãy nhanh lên và vào tới bờ nơi không bị rủi ro trượt ngã.

id: Ada rawa berbau ganjil. Ada kabut aneh di atas permukaan air yang bergolak. Tidak ada gunanya di sini lebih lama.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_730_DESCRIPTION
desc: You've come to an odd smelling marshland. A strange fog hangs above the water's bubbling bottomless surface. There's no use sticking around here any longer.

raw.en: You've come to an odd smelling marshland. A strange fog hangs above the water's bubbling bottomless surface. There's no use sticking around here any longer.
raw.es: Has llegado a un páramo extraño que apesta. Una extraña niebla viaja sobre la superficie burbujeante del agua sin fondo. No hay razón para quedarse aquí más tiempo.
raw.id: Ada rawa berbau ganjil. Ada kabut aneh di atas permukaan air yang bergolak. Tidak ada gunanya di sini lebih lama.
raw.pt: Você chegou a um terreno pantanoso de cheiro esquisito. Uma estranha névoa paira sobre a água borbulhante e sem fundo. Não tem porquê se demorar aqui.
raw.th: คุณมาถึงลุ่มน้ำที่มีกลิ่นแปลกๆ กบประหลาดลอยคออยู่เหนือน้ำที่มองลงไปไม่เห็นพื้น ไม่มีประโยชน์ที่จะคอยอยู่แถวนี้ไปนานๆ
raw.vi: Ngươi đã đến một vùng đầm lầy có mùi lạ. Một đám sương mù kỳ lạ treo lơ lửng trên bề mặt sủi bọt nước không thấy đáy. Quanh quẩn nơi đây thêm nữa cũng chẳng làm gì.

id: Bau yang bikin mual menguar di udara lembap. Saat baunya hilang, sekarang malah bau tanaman yang mencekik.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_731_DESCRIPTION
desc: A stomach-turning stench fills the moist humid air. Even when the bad smell breaks, you're left with the choking fragrance of vegetation.

raw.en: A stomach-turning stench fills the moist humid air. Even when the bad smell breaks, you're left with the choking fragrance of vegetation.
raw.es: El hedor del aire húmedo te revuelve el estómago. Incluso cuando la pestilencia te da respiro, te encuentras con la asfixiante fragancia de la vegetación.
raw.id: Bau yang bikin mual menguar di udara lembap. Saat baunya hilang, sekarang malah bau tanaman yang mencekik.
raw.pt: Um fedor de embrlhar o estômago toma conta do ar úmido. Mesmo quando o fedor passa, ainda sobra a fragrância sufocante da vegetação.
raw.th: กลิ่นเหม็นชวนอาเจียนลอยฟุ้งเต็มอากาศที่ชื้น แม้ว่ากลิ่นแย่ๆ จะจางหายไปแล้ว แต่คุณก็จากมาพร้อมกับกลิ่นเหม็นเขียวติดอยู่ในลำคอ
raw.vi: Một mùi hôi thối từ dạ dày tràn ngập không khí ẩm ướt. Ngay cả khi phá vỡ mùi hôi đó, ngươi vẫn còn hương thơm nghẹt thở của đám cây cối.

id: Monster melompat, menyerang dari air lumpur dan juga semak tebal. Ngos-ngosan, tetapi tidak ada tempat istirahat.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_732_DESCRIPTION
desc: Monsters leap in attack from both the muddied water as well as the thick shrubs. You'd like to catch your breath, but it seems there's nowhere to rest.

raw.en: Monsters leap in attack from both the muddied water as well as the thick shrubs. You'd like to catch your breath, but it seems there's nowhere to rest.
raw.es: Los monstruos salen tanto de los gruesos arbustos como del agua embarrada para atacarte. Sería ideal tomarse un descanso, pero parece que no hay ningún lugar para recuperarse.
raw.id: Monster melompat, menyerang dari air lumpur dan juga semak tebal. Ngos-ngosan, tetapi tidak ada tempat istirahat.
raw.pt: Monstros pulam pra atacar tanto lodo aguacento quanto dos arbustos. Você quer pegar um fôlego, mas parece que não há onde descansar.
raw.th: มอนสเตอร์กระโดดเข้าใส่เพื่อโจมตีจากน้ำโคลนทั้งสองด้านและพุ่มไม้หนา คุณอยากจะพักหายใจสักหน่อยแต่ดูเหมือนว่า มันจะไม่มีที่ให้คุณได้พักเสียแล้ว
raw.vi: Lũ quái vật nhào ra tấn công từ cả vùng nước hỗn độn cũng như các đám cây bụi dày. Ngươi như muốn ngừng thở, nhưng dường như không có chỗ nào để nghỉ.

id: Tiba-tiba racun dari rawa menghilang. Udara yang tadinya bikin sesak napas kini segar dan bersih. Ini mengkhawatirkan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_733_DESCRIPTION
desc: Suddenly, the miasma from the bog disappears. The air which was once difficult to breath is now fresh and clean. This is likely cause for concern.

raw.en: Suddenly, the miasma from the bog disappears. The air which was once difficult to breath is now fresh and clean. This is likely cause for concern.
raw.es: De repente, el miasma del pantano desaparece. El aire que prácticamente no se podía respirar, ahora es fresco y limpio. Sin dudas, esto es razón para preocuparse.
raw.id: Tiba-tiba racun dari rawa menghilang. Udara yang tadinya bikin sesak napas kini segar dan bersih. Ini mengkhawatirkan.
raw.pt: Subitamente, o miasma do brejo some. O ar que antes era difícil de respirar agora é fresco e limpo. Isso provavelmente é um problema.
raw.th: ทันใดนั้น พิษจากบึงหายไป อากาศซึ่งครั้งหนึ่งทำให้ยากที่จะหายใจ ขณะนี้กลับสดชื่นและสะอาด นี้ควรจะเป็นสาเหตุให้รู้สึกกังวลใช่ไหม
raw.vi: Đột nhiên, chướng khí từ đầm lầy biến mất. Không khí đã từng gây khó thở nay thật tươi mát và sạch sẽ. Điều này có thể gây ra lo ngại.

id: Berhasil melalui jalanan berlumpur. Akhir rawa sudah delat, tapi pohon besar menghadang di depan. Pasti bukan pohon biasa.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_734_DESCRIPTION
desc: You've made it a long way down the muddy path. The end of the marsh is near, but a remarkably large tree stands in front of you. Surely it isn't an ordinary tree.

raw.en: You've made it a long way down the muddy path. The end of the marsh is near, but a remarkably large tree stands in front of you. Surely it isn't an ordinary tree.
raw.es: Has avanzado mucho por el camino embarrado. El final de la marisma está cerca, pero delante de ti se alza un árbol sumamente grande. Está claro que no es un árbol común y corriente.
raw.id: Berhasil melalui jalanan berlumpur. Akhir rawa sudah delat, tapi pohon besar menghadang di depan. Pasti bukan pohon biasa.
raw.pt: Você veio longe pelo caminho lodoso. O final do pântano está próximo, mas uma árvore notavelmente grande está à sua frente. Com certeza não é uma árvore comum.
raw.th: คุณได้ย่ำผ่านเส้นทางยาวที่เต็มไปด้วยโคลนมาแล้ว ใกล้จะสุดเขตพื้นที่ลุ่มน้ำแล้ว แต่ต้นไม้ใหญ่จนเป็นที่สังเกตุได้กำลังขวางหน้าคุณอยู่ แน่นอนว่ามันต้องไม่ใช่ต้นไม้ธรรมดา
raw.vi: Ngươi đã đeo đuổi lâu dài con đường lầy lội này. Điểm cuối đầm lầy đang rất gần, nhưng một cái cây khá lớn đang chắn trước mặt ngươi. Chắc chắn đó không phải là một cái cây bình thường.

id: Awan badai hitam memenuhi langit. Petir menghunjam hutan tanpa henti. Tidak mungkin ada yang bisa hidup di sini.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_740_DESCRIPTION
desc: Deep black storm clouds fill the sky. Lightning falls in endless waves upon the forest below. There's no way anything could live here.

raw.en: Deep black storm clouds fill the sky. Lightning falls in endless waves upon the forest below. There's no way anything could live here.
raw.es: Nubes profundas y oscuras llenan el cielo. Los rayos caen sobre el bosque en infinitas oleadas. Es imposible que haya algo con vida en este lugar.
raw.id: Awan badai hitam memenuhi langit. Petir menghunjam hutan tanpa henti. Tidak mungkin ada yang bisa hidup di sini.
raw.pt: Uma nuvem de tempestade tão negra quanto profunda toma conta do céu. Os relâmpagos caem incessantemente sobre a floresta abaixo. Não tem maneira de algo conseguir viver aqui.
raw.th: เมฆฝนดำมืดอยู่เต็มท้องฟ้า สายฟ้าฟาดลงมาอย่างไม่สิ้นสุดใส่ป่าที่อยู่ด้านล่าง ไม่มีทางที่จะมีสิ่งมีชีวิตอยู่ที่นี่ได้แน่ๆ
raw.vi: Những đám mây bão đen kịt đang che phủ bầu trời. Sét rơi xuống thừng trận bất tận lên khu rừng dưới đây. Chẳng thứ gì có thể sống ở đây.

id: Telinga mulai berdenging akibat petir beruntun. Udaranya padat dengan bau pohon terbakar yang tersambar petir.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_741_DESCRIPTION
desc: Your ears begin ringing as lightning endlessly crashes down. The air is thick with the odor of a burnt tree which has been struck by lightning.

raw.en: Your ears begin ringing as lightning endlessly crashes down. The air is thick with the odor of a burnt tree which has been struck by lightning.
raw.es: Tus oídos comienzan a silbar mientras la electricidad cae sobre el suelo. El aire está viciado con el olor de un árbol quemado que fue azotado por un rayo.
raw.id: Telinga mulai berdenging akibat petir beruntun. Udaranya padat dengan bau pohon terbakar yang tersambar petir.
raw.pt: Seus ouvidos começam a zunir, conforme os raios caem impiedosamente. O ar está tomado pelo cheiro de uma árvore queimada que foi acertada por um raio.
raw.th: หูของคุณเริ่มอื้อเมื่อสายฟ้าคะนองลงมาอย่างไม่สิ้นสุด ในอากาศเต็มไปด้วยกลิ่นของต้นไม้ที่เผาไหม้เพราะถูกฟ้าผ่า
raw.vi: Đôi tai ngươi bắt đầu ong ong khi sấm chớp không ngừng dội xuống. Không khí quánh đặc mùi khét từ một cây bị cháy do sét đánh.

id: Pepohonan di isni sepertinya tahan terhadap petir. Namun memperhatikan ini, malah bikin tersesat.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_742_DESCRIPTION
desc: The trees here seem able to withstand exposure to lightning. However, in noticing this it seems you have become lost.

raw.en: The trees here seem able to withstand exposure to lightning. However, in noticing this it seems you have become lost.
raw.es: Parece que aquí, los árboles son capaces de resistir la electricidad. Sin embargo, te das cuenta de que te has perdido.
raw.id: Pepohonan di isni sepertinya tahan terhadap petir. Namun memperhatikan ini, malah bikin tersesat.
raw.pt: As árvores aqui parecem ser resistentes à exposição aos raios. Porém, ao notar isso você se perdeu.
raw.th: ดูเหมือนว่าต้นไม้แถวนี้จะทนทานสายฟ้าที่ผ่าลงมาได้ อย่างไรก็ตามขณะที่คุณสังเกตเรื่องนี้ได้ ดูเหมือนว่าคุณก็จะรู้ตัวเองว่าหลงทางแล้วเช่นกัน
raw.vi: Cây cối ở đây dường như có thể chịu được tiếp xúc với sấm sét. Tuy nhiên, khi nhận ra điều này có vẻ như ngươi đã bị lạc lối.

id: Kehadiran yang melumpuhkan ada di hutan. Aura ini… sepertinya pjuang yang pernah kauhadapi, menunggumu lagi.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_743_DESCRIPTION
desc: A paralyzing presence inhabits the forest. You recognize this aura. It seems a warrior you've faced before awaits you once again.

raw.en: A paralyzing presence inhabits the forest. You recognize this aura. It seems a warrior you've faced before awaits you once again.
raw.es: Una presencia paralizante habita el bosque. Reconoces el aura. Parece que un guerrero al que ya te has enfrentado te espera nuevamente.
raw.id: Kehadiran yang melumpuhkan ada di hutan. Aura ini… sepertinya pjuang yang pernah kauhadapi, menunggumu lagi.
raw.pt: Uma presença paralisante habita a floresta. Você reconhece sua aura. Parece que um herói que você já enfrentou te espera de novo.
raw.th: สิ่งที่ทำให้เกิดอาการอัมพาตได้นั้นอาศัยอยู่ในป่านี้ คุณจำออร่าแบบนี้ได้ ดูเหมือนว่านักรบที่คุณเคยเผชิญหน้ามาก่อน กำลังคอยคุณอยู่อีกครั้งหนึ่ง
raw.vi: Quang cảnh tê liệt đang ngự trị nơi cánh rừng. Ngươi sẽ nhận ra hào quang này. Dường như một chiến binh ngươi đã phải đối mặt trước kia đang chờ đợi ngươi một lần nữa.

id: Langit semakin cerah. Sepertinya sebentar lagi bisa lolos dari cuaca aneh ini. Apa Lugina menunggu di depan seperti janjinya?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_744_DESCRIPTION
desc: The sky has become brighter. It seems you might soon be able to escape this strange weather. Is Lugina waiting ahead like he said he'd be?

raw.en: The sky has become brighter. It seems you might soon be able to escape this strange weather. Is Lugina waiting ahead like he said he'd be?
raw.es: El cielo es más brillante. Parece que al fin podrás escapar de este extraño clima. ¿Lugina te estará esperando más adelante como dijo?
raw.id: Langit semakin cerah. Sepertinya sebentar lagi bisa lolos dari cuaca aneh ini. Apa Lugina menunggu di depan seperti janjinya?
raw.pt: O céu ficou mais claro. Parece que talvez você possa escapar desse clima estranho. O Lugina está esperando adiante como disse que estaria?
raw.th: ท้องฟ้าดูสว่างขึ้น ดูเหมือนว่าอีกไม่นานคุณก็จะหลุดพ้นจากอากาศแปรปรวนเช่นนี้แล้ว ลูจิน่าจะคอยอยู่ข้างหน้าอย่างที่เขาบอกไหมนะ?
raw.vi: Bầu trời đã trở nên tươi sáng hơn. Dường như ngươi có thể sớm thoát khỏi thời tiết kỳ lạ này. Lugina đang chờ ngươi phía trước như anh ta đã nói?

id: Tiba di puing Republik La Veda.  Meski rusak, masih ada jejak orang-orang yang tadinya tinggal di sini.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_750_DESCRIPTION
desc: You've arrived at the ruins of the La Veda Republic. As ravaged as it is, there are still traces in the rubble of the people who used to live here.

raw.en: You've arrived at the ruins of the La Veda Republic. As ravaged as it is, there are still traces in the rubble of the people who used to live here.
raw.es: Has llegado a las ruinas de la república de La Veda. Si bien está devastada, en los escombros logras ver huellas de la gente que antaño vivió aquí.
raw.id: Tiba di puing Republik La Veda.  Meski rusak, masih ada jejak orang-orang yang tadinya tinggal di sini.
raw.pt: Você chegou nas ruínas da República de La Veda. Por mais destruída que esteja, ainda há traços das pessoas que viviam aqui.
raw.th: คุณได้มาถึงซากของเมือง ลา วีดา ในความย่อยยับนี้ก็ยังคงมีร่องรอยของผู้คนที่เคยอาศัยอยู่ที่นี่
raw.vi: Ngươi đã đến những tàn tích của Cộng hòa La Veda. Do bị tàn phá, vẫn còn các dấu vết trong đống đổ nát của những người từng sống ở đây.

id: Ada ukiran detail di batu dekat kakimu. Sisa-sisa serbuk dari gedung menunjukkan betapa ganas perang yang terjadi di sini.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_751_DESCRIPTION
desc: You notice elaborate carvings in the pieces of stone around your feet. The powderized remains of buildings speak of the violent battle that took place here.

raw.en: You notice elaborate carvings in the pieces of stone around your feet. The powderized remains of buildings speak of the violent battle that took place here.
raw.es: Puedes ver símbolos elaborados tallados sobre las piedras que tienes a los pies. Los restos polvorientos de las edificaciones dan cuenta de la violenta batalla que se libró en este lugar.
raw.id: Ada ukiran detail di batu dekat kakimu. Sisa-sisa serbuk dari gedung menunjukkan betapa ganas perang yang terjadi di sini.
raw.pt: Você nota entalhes elaboratos nas peças e pedra onde pisa. Os restos pulverizados dos prédios contam sobre a violenta batalha que se passou aqui.
raw.th: คุณสังเกตเห็นการแกะสลักอย่างประณีตในชิ้นส่วนของหินรอบๆ เท้าของคุณ เศษซากของอาคารได้บอกเล่าเรื่องราวของสงครามรุนแรงที่เกิดขึ้นที่นี่
raw.vi: Ngươi nhận thấy những chạm khắc công phu trong các mảnh đá quanh chân ngươi. Phần tòa nhà còn lại đầy bụi bặm nói lên một cuộc chiến bạo lực đã diễn ra ở đây.

id: Meski reruntuhan ini terpencil, tidak ada tanda senjata atau sisa-sisa mayat, dan udaranya terasa bersih dan segar.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_752_DESCRIPTION
desc: Despite how desolate these ruins are, there are no signs of weapons or human remains, and the air is fresh and clean.

raw.en: Despite how desolate these ruins are, there are no signs of weapons or human remains, and the air is fresh and clean.
raw.es: A pesar de lo desoladas que son estas ruinas, no hay señales de armas ni de restos humanos, y el aire es fresco y limpio.
raw.id: Meski reruntuhan ini terpencil, tidak ada tanda senjata atau sisa-sisa mayat, dan udaranya terasa bersih dan segar.
raw.pt: Apesar do quão desoladas são essas ruínas, não há sinais de armas ou restos humanos, e o ar é fresco e limpo.
raw.th: แม้ว่าซากเหล่านี้จะดูรกร้าง แต่ก็ไม่มีวี่แววของซากมนุษย์กับอาวุธอยู่เลย และอากาศก็สดชื่น สะอาดมาก
raw.vi: Cho dù những tàn tích đổ nát thật thê lương, vẫn không có dấu hiệu nào về vũ khí hay con người, và không khí vẫn trong lành và sạch sẽ.

id: Melanjutkan pencarian di puing, kehadiran mencolok menghentikan langkahmu. Di depan, ksatria Republik La Veda menunggu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_753_DESCRIPTION
desc: Continuing your search of the ruins, an overwhelming presence stops you in your tracks. Up ahead, a knight of the La Veda Republic lies in wait.

raw.en: Continuing your search of the ruins, an overwhelming presence stops you in your tracks. Up ahead, a knight of the La Veda Republic lies in wait.
raw.es: Continúas tu búsqueda por las ruinas, pero una presencia apabullante te detiene abruptamente. Adelante, te espera un caballero de la república de La Veda.
raw.id: Melanjutkan pencarian di puing, kehadiran mencolok menghentikan langkahmu. Di depan, ksatria Republik La Veda menunggu.
raw.pt: Continuando a busca por ruínas, uma presença incrível impede seu avanço. Adiante, um cavaleiro da República de La Veda aguarda.
raw.th: คุณทำการค้นหาในซากโบราณต่อไป ร่างทรงพลังก็มาหยุดคุณไม่ให้ไปต่อ ข้างหน้านั้น คืออัศวินของ ลา วีดา ที่กำลังคอยอยู่
raw.vi: Khi tiếp tục tìm kiếm trong những đống đổ nát, một sự hiện diện áp đảo ngăn cản ngươi tiến bước. Ngay phía trước, một hiệp sĩ của Cộng hòa La Veda đang nằm yên chờ đợi.

id: Rumah terbakar, gereja runtuh. Pasti banyak penduduk yang tinggal di kota sebesar ini. Semoga arwah para korban beristirahat dengan tenang.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_754_DESCRIPTION
desc: Burnt houses, crumbling churches. There must've been many residents in a city as large as this. You can't help but hope that the victims have found peace.

raw.en: Burnt houses, crumbling churches. There must've been many residents in a city as large as this. You can't help but hope that the victims have found peace.
raw.es: Casas quemadas, iglesias derruidas. En una ciudad tan grande como esta, deben haber vivido muchas personas. Tu único anhelo es que esta gente haya encontrado la paz.
raw.id: Rumah terbakar, gereja runtuh. Pasti banyak penduduk yang tinggal di kota sebesar ini. Semoga arwah para korban beristirahat dengan tenang.
raw.pt: Casas queimadas, igrejas em ruínas. Uma cidade desse tamanho deve ter tido muitos habitantes. Só resta a esperança de que as vítimas encontraram a paz.
raw.th: บ้านที่ไหม้ โบสถ์ที่พังทลาย คงไม่เคยมีเมืองไหนที่มีประชากรเยอะขนาดที่นี่มาก่อนแน่ๆ คุณไม่สามารถช่วยอะไรได้เลยนอกจากหวังว่าเหยื่อทั้งหลายจะไปสู่สุขติ
raw.vi: Nhà bị đốt cháy, nhà thờ đổ nát. Chắc đã phải có rất nhiều người sống trong một thành phố lớn như này. Ngươi không thể giúp đỡ gì được nhưng hy vọng các nạn nhân đã tìm thấy sự an bình.

id: Paris bilang ada kuil Dewa Terang di sekitar sini. Kekuatan besar hadir di depanmu seakan melindungi jiwa orang-orang yang dikhianati para dewa.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_755_DESCRIPTION
desc: Paris said there should be a shrine dedicated to the God of Light around here. A great force stands before you as if to protect the souls of those betrayed by the gods.

raw.en: Paris said there should be a shrine dedicated to the God of Light around here. A great force stands before you as if to protect the souls of those betrayed by the gods.
raw.es: Paris dijo que cerca de aquí debería haber un templo erigido en nombre del Dios de la Luz. Delante de ti se alza una gran fuerza, como si protegiera las almas de aquellos traicionados por los dioses.
raw.id: Paris bilang ada kuil Dewa Terang di sekitar sini. Kekuatan besar hadir di depanmu seakan melindungi jiwa orang-orang yang dikhianati para dewa.
raw.pt: Paris disse que deveria haver um santuário dedicado ao Deus da Luz por aqui. Uma grande força se põe à sua frente, como se para proteger as almas daqueles traídos pelos deuses.
raw.th: ปารีสบอกไว้ว่า แถวนี้น่าจะมีวิหารที่สร้างขึ้นเพื่อบูชาเทพแห่งแสงอยู่ พลังที่ยิ่งใหญ่ยืนขวางหน้าคุณอยู่ ราวกับว่าจะปกป้องวิญญาณของคนที่ถูกทรยศโดยเทพเจ้า
raw.vi: Paris đã nói lẽ ra có một ngôi đền dành riêng cho Quang Thần quanh đây. Một lực lượng to lớn đứng trước mặt ngươi như thể để bảo vệ linh hồn của những người bị phản bội bởi các vị thần.

id: Tiba di pinggiran kota, ada jembatan yang sangat besar. Sebelum naik jembatan, hadapi dulu naga raksasa yang mengikutimu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_756_DESCRIPTION
desc: Arriving at the outskirts of the city you see a shockingly massive bridge. Before you can get to it you must confront the huge dragon on your tail.

raw.en: Arriving at the outskirts of the city you see a shockingly massive bridge. Before you can get to it you must confront the huge dragon on your tail.
raw.es: Llegas a la periferia de la ciudad y te encuentras con un puente gigante. Antes de que puedas cruzarlo, debes enfrentarte a un dragón enorme.
raw.id: Tiba di pinggiran kota, ada jembatan yang sangat besar. Sebelum naik jembatan, hadapi dulu naga raksasa yang mengikutimu.
raw.pt: Chegando à periferia da cidade você encontra uma ponte impressionantemente massiva. Antes de chegar a ela você deve confrontar o enorme dragão que te segue.
raw.th: เมื่อมาถึงรอบนอกของเมือง คุณมองเห็นสะพานที่ใหญ่มหึมาจนน่าตกใจ ก่อนที่คุณจะไปถึงมันได้นั้น คุณจะต้องจัดการกับมังกรยักษ์ที่ตามคุณมาเสียก่อน
raw.vi: Về đến vùng ngoại ô của thành phố ngươi nhìn thấy một cây cầu lớn đến kinh hoàng. Trước khi đến được đó, ngươi phải đối đầu với con rồng khổng lồ đang theo đuôi ngươi.

id: Berdiri di dekat jembatan, rasanya terlihat lebih besar daripada jarak jauh. Menara mengerikan terlihat di kejauhan, tapi apakah itu akhirnya?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_760_DESCRIPTION
desc: Now that you stand near the bridge it looks a lot bigger than it seamed from far away. You can see an ominous tower far in the distance, but could that be the end?

raw.en: Now that you stand near the bridge it looks a lot bigger than it seamed from far away. You can see an ominous tower far in the distance, but could that be the end?
raw.es: Ahora que estás cerca del puente, te das cuenta de que en realidad era mucho más grande de lo que parecía. A lo lejos puedes ver una torre siniestra. ¿Acaso ese es el final?
raw.id: Berdiri di dekat jembatan, rasanya terlihat lebih besar daripada jarak jauh. Menara mengerikan terlihat di kejauhan, tapi apakah itu akhirnya?
raw.pt: Agora que você está mais perto da ponte ela parece ainda maior do que de longe. Você pode ver uma torre sinistra à distância, mas será que é o fim?
raw.th: ขณะนี้เมื่อคุณยืนอยู่ใกล้กับสะพาย มันดูใหญ่ยิ่งกว่าตอนที่คุณมองจากที่ไกลๆ มากยิ่งนัก คุณสามารถมองเห็นหอคอยที่ดูไม่น่าไว้ใจได้จากที่ไกลๆ แต่นั่นจะใช้จุดจบของการเดินทางหรือเปล่า?
raw.vi: Giờ đây ngươi đang đứng gần cây cầu có vẻ lớn hơn rất nhiều so với khi thấy nó từ xa. Ngươi có thể thấy một tòa tháp quái gở phía xa, nhưng liệu đó có thể là dấu chấm hết?

id: Berbalik, ada puing. Dibandingkan tempat terpencil yang murni itu, jembatan bermandikan racun buruk. Apa yang menunggu di depan?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_761_DESCRIPTION
desc: Turning back, you see the ruins. Compared to that desolate yet pure place, the bridge is soaked in an ominous miasma. What could be waiting ahead?

raw.en: Turning back, you see the ruins. Compared to that desolate yet pure place, the bridge is soaked in an ominous miasma. What could be waiting ahead?
raw.es: Te das vuelta y ves las ruinas. Comparado a aquel lugar desolado y puro, el puente parece estar cubierto de un miasma maligno. ¿Qué es lo que espera más adelante?
raw.id: Berbalik, ada puing. Dibandingkan tempat terpencil yang murni itu, jembatan bermandikan racun buruk. Apa yang menunggu di depan?
raw.pt: Virando-se, você vê as ruínas. Comparada ao lugar desolado porém puro, a ponte está coberta por um miasma sinistro. O que pode estar esperando logo adiante?
raw.th: เมื่อหันหลังไป คุณมองเห็นซากอาคาร เมื่อเทียบกับสถานที่บริสุทธิ์แต่รกร้างนั่นแล้ว สะพานนี้กลับชุ่มไปด้วยไอของความชั่วร้าย มีอะไรคอยอยู่ข้างหน้ากันนะ?
raw.vi: Quay trở lại, ngươi nhìn thấy những đống đổ nát. So với nơi thuần khiết hoang vắng đó, cây cầu đang ngập tràn chướng khí quái gở. Cái gì đang chực chờ phía trước?

id: Semakin dekat menara, semakin takut. Seakan menaranya berisi energi jahat.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_762_DESCRIPTION
desc: The closer you get to the tower, the more hightened your fear becomes. It's as if the tower itself was infused with some sort of evil energy.

raw.en: The closer you get to the tower, the more hightened your fear becomes. It's as if the tower itself was infused with some sort of evil energy.
raw.es: Mientras más te acercas a la torre, más crece tu miedo. Es como si la mismísima torre estuviera insuflada con energía maligna.
raw.id: Semakin dekat menara, semakin takut. Seakan menaranya berisi energi jahat.
raw.pt: Quanto mais perto você chega da torre, mais intenso fica o seu medo. É como se a própria torre estivesse tomada por um tipo de energia vil.
raw.th: ยิ่งคุณเข้าใกล้หอคอยเท่าไหร่ ความกลัวของคุณก็ยิ่งเพิ่มมากขึ้น ราวกับว่าหอคอยนั่นอาบไว้ด้วยพลังงานชั่วร้ายบางอย่าง
raw.vi: Càng đến gần ngọn tháp, sự sợ hãi của ngươi càng dâng cao. Đó là vì chính ngọn tháp này được tiêm nhiễm bởi một loại năng lượng quỷ dị.

id: Akhirnya kau berhasil sampai pertengahan jembatan. Musuh semakin kuat, pertarungan berikutnya akan lebih sulit.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_763_DESCRIPTION
desc: You've finally made it to the bridge's halfway point. As the enemies are growing stronger, it seems fighting through the second half will only be more difficult.

raw.en: You've finally made it to the bridge's halfway point. As the enemies are growing stronger, it seems fighting through the second half will only be more difficult.
raw.es: Finalmente has llegado a la mitad del puente. Los enemigos son cada vez más fuerte. Parece que atravesar la segunda mitad será incluso más difícil.
raw.id: Akhirnya kau berhasil sampai pertengahan jembatan. Musuh semakin kuat, pertarungan berikutnya akan lebih sulit.
raw.pt: Você finalmente chegou à metade da ponte. Conforme os inimigos ficam mais fortes, parece que a segunda metade da ponte será muito mais difícil.
raw.th: ในที่สุดคุณก็มาถึงจุดกึ่งกลางของสะพาน  ขณะที่ศัตรูทั้งหลายนั้นแข็งแกร่งมากขึ้น ก็ดูเหมือนว่าการต่อสู้ในช่วงที่เหลือก็จะยากยิ่งขึ้นไปกว่าเดิม
raw.vi: Rốt cuộc ngươi cũng đã đến được chỗ nửa đường trên cây cầu. Bởi kẻ thù ngày càng mạnh hơn, dường như chiến đấu qua đến hiệp thứ hai sẽ chỉ gặp nhiều khó khăn hơn.

id: Musuh terus menyerang, tidak bisa istirahat. Apa mereka melindungi kekuatan yang kata Paris disembunyikan di sini?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_764_DESCRIPTION
desc: Enemies continue attacking, allowing no room for rest. Could they be protecting the power that Paris said was hidden here?

raw.en: Enemies continue attacking, allowing no room for rest. Could they be protecting the power that Paris said was hidden here?
raw.es: Los enemigos siguen atacando, y no te dan respiro. ¿Acaso estarán protegiendo el poder que Paris dice que yace en este lugar?
raw.id: Musuh terus menyerang, tidak bisa istirahat. Apa mereka melindungi kekuatan yang kata Paris disembunyikan di sini?
raw.pt: Os inimigos continuam atacando, sem tempo para descanso. Será que eles protegem o poder que Paris disse que estava escondido aqui?
raw.th: ศัตรูโจมตีมาเรื่อยๆ โดยไม่ยอมให้มีโอกาสได้พัก บางที่พวกมันอาจจะกำลังปกป้องพลังที่ปารีสบอกไว้ว่าซ่อนอยู่แถวนี้ใช่ไหม?
raw.vi: Kẻ thù đang tiếp tục tấn công, không còn chỗ nghỉ ngơi. Có thể nào chúng đang bảo vệ sức mạnh mà Paris nói đã được ẩn náu ở đây?

id: Cukup dekat ke menara, sehingga harus mendongak untuk melihat ujungnya. Penampilannya ganjil, sehingga kau tercekat.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_765_DESCRIPTION
desc: You're close enough to the tower that you have to look up to see where it ends. It's odd appearance causes a lump in your throught.

raw.en: You're close enough to the tower that you have to look up to see where it ends. It's odd appearance causes a lump in your throught.
raw.es: Estás muy cerca de la torre, y si miras hacia arriba, puedes ver donde termina. Su extraño aspecto te turba el pensamiento.
raw.id: Cukup dekat ke menara, sehingga harus mendongak untuk melihat ujungnya. Penampilannya ganjil, sehingga kau tercekat.
raw.pt: Você está perto o suficiente da torre para precisar olhar para cima para ver seu topo. A aparência estranha dela causa um caroço no seu pensamento.
raw.th: คุณเข้าใกล้หอคอยมากพอที่จะมองขึ้นไปถึงยอด รูปร่างของมันแปลกจนทำให้คุณต้องฉุกคิด
raw.vi: Ngươi đến ngọn tháp đủ gần để tìm kiếm xem nó kết thúc ở đâu. Sự xuất hiện kỳ lạ của nó đã khiến tâm tưởng ngươi đình trệ.

id: Sebentar lagi sampai menara. Lugina masih belum muncul, kemungkinan besar ia menunggu di sekitar sini. Berhati-hatilah.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_766_DESCRIPTION
desc: Not much longer to the tower. Lugina still hasn't shown up yet so it's highly likely he's waiting somewhere around here. Proceed with caution.

raw.en: Not much longer to the tower. Lugina still hasn't shown up yet so it's highly likely he's waiting somewhere around here. Proceed with caution.
raw.es: No falta mucho para la torre. Lugina todavía no ha aparecido, por lo que es probable que esté esperando en algún lugar cercano. Avanza con cuidado.
raw.id: Sebentar lagi sampai menara. Lugina masih belum muncul, kemungkinan besar ia menunggu di sekitar sini. Berhati-hatilah.
raw.pt: Não falta muito até a torre. Lugina ainda não apareceu então é provável que ele esteja esperando em algum lugar por aqui. Prossiga com cuidado.
raw.th: อีกไม่นานก็ถึงหอคอยแล้ว ลูจิน่าก็ยังไม่โผล่มา ฉะนั้นเป็นไปได้ว่าเขาอาจจะกำลังรออยู่แถวนี้ จงเดินหน้าต่อไปด้วยความระมัดระวัง
raw.vi: Không còn xa với ngọn tháp. Lugina vẫn chưa hiện thân nên rất có thể ông ta đang chờ đâu đó quanh đây. Hãy tiến hành thận trọng.

id: Ada pintu baja tebal di jalan masuk menara. Meski terbuka, kalahkan dulu monster sebelum masuk ke dalam.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_770_DESCRIPTION
desc: There is a thick steel door at the entrance to the tower. Although it is open, you must defeat the monsters around you before going inside.

raw.en: There is a thick steel door at the entrance to the tower. Although it is open, you must defeat the monsters around you before going inside.
raw.es: Hay una gruesa puerta de acero en la entrada de la torre. Si bien está abierta, tendrás que derrotar a los monstruos para poder entrar.
raw.id: Ada pintu baja tebal di jalan masuk menara. Meski terbuka, kalahkan dulu monster sebelum masuk ke dalam.
raw.pt: Tem uma porta de aço espessa na entrada da torre. Apesar de aberta, você deve derrotar os monstros ao seu redor antes de entrar.
raw.th: มีประตูเหล็กหนาอยู่ที่ทางเข้าของหอคอย แม้ว่ามันจะเปิดอยู่ แต่คุณก็ต้องกำจัดมอนสเตอร์ที่อยู่รอบตัวคุณสียก่อนที่จะเข้าไปได้
raw.vi: Có một cánh cửa thép dày nằm ngay lối vào tòa tháp. Mặc dù nó đang mở, ngươi phải đánh bại những con quái vật xung quanh trước khi vào được bên trong.

id: Masuk ke dalam, keseluruhan menara agak bergetar. Hilangkan rasa negatif ini dan fokuslah pada musuh di depan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_771_DESCRIPTION
desc: Entering inside you notice the entire tower is slightly trembling. You must shake off this bad feeling and focus on the enemy in front of you.

raw.en: Entering inside you notice the entire tower is slightly trembling. You must shake off this bad feeling and focus on the enemy in front of you.
raw.es: Cuando entras a la torre, te percatas de que tiembla levemente. Haz que esta impresión maligna desaparezca y concentrarte en el enemigo que tienes delante de ti.
raw.id: Masuk ke dalam, keseluruhan menara agak bergetar. Hilangkan rasa negatif ini dan fokuslah pada musuh di depan.
raw.pt: Entrando, você nota que a torre inteira está tremendo levemente. Você precisa se livrar desse pressentimento ruim e se focar no inimigo à sua frente.
raw.th: เมื่อเข้าไปข้างใน คุณสังเกตว่าหอคอยทั้งหลังกำลังสั่นสะเทือน คุณจะต้องสลัดความคิดแย่ๆ นี้ทิ้งและสนใจไปที่ศัตรูที่อยู่ตรงหน้าของคุณ
raw.vi: Bước vào bên trong ngươi nhận thấy toàn bộ tòa tháp hơi run rẩy. Ngươi phải rũ bỏ cảm giác xấu đó và tập trung vào kẻ thù trước mặt ngươi.

id: Masih jauh sampai ke puncak, dan di puncak ada lebih banyak musuh daripada di luar. Apa yang tadi dikatakan Paris mulai mengusikmu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_772_DESCRIPTION
desc: It's a long way to the top, and on top of that there are even more enemies here than outside. What Paris said now stirs uneasiness within you.

raw.en: It's a long way to the top, and on top of that there are even more enemies here than outside. What Paris said now stirs uneasiness within you.
raw.es: El camino a la cima es muy largo, y parece que aquí hay muchos más enemigos que afuera. Lo que ha dicho Paris te llena de ansiedad.
raw.id: Masih jauh sampai ke puncak, dan di puncak ada lebih banyak musuh daripada di luar. Apa yang tadi dikatakan Paris mulai mengusikmu.
raw.pt: É um longo caminho até o topo, e no topo tem ainda mais inimigos do que do lado de fora. O que Paris disse agora te deixa desconfortável.
raw.th: เป็นทางที่ยาวกว่าจุถึงชั้นบนสุด และยิ่งกว่านั้นมอนสเตอร์ในนี้มีเยอะกว่าข้างนอกเสียอีก สิ่งที่ปารีสเพิ่งบอกไปมันเริ่มสร้างความไม่สบายใจให้คุณแล้ว
raw.vi: Đó là một chặng đường dài để lên đỉnh, và trên đó thậm chí còn nhiều kẻ thù hơn bên ngoài. Những gì Paris đã nói khiến ngươi trào dâng lo lắng.

id: Menara makin bergetar. Suara ritmik berdentum di dadamu. Apa yang katanya Paris lihat di sini?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_773_DESCRIPTION
desc: The tower's shaking has grown stronger. The oppressive rythmic sound bears heavily on your chest. What is it that Paris saw here?

raw.en: The tower's shaking has grown stronger. The oppressive rythmic sound bears heavily on your chest. What is it that Paris saw here?
raw.es: El temblor de la torre se ha hecho más fuerte. El sonido opresivo te asalta el pecho. ¿Qué vio Paris aquí?
raw.id: Menara makin bergetar. Suara ritmik berdentum di dadamu. Apa yang katanya Paris lihat di sini?
raw.pt: O tremor da torre ficou mais forte. O ritmo opressor do som pesa no seu peito. O que foi que Paris viu aqui?
raw.th: หอคอยยิ่งสั่นมากขึ้นกว่าเดิม เสียงทุ้มหนักกระทุ้งเข้าไปในอกของคุณ ปารีสได้พบกับอะไรที่นี่กันแน่?
raw.vi: Tòa tháp ngày càng rung lắc mạnh hơn. Những âm thanh dồn dập áp bức khiến ngực ngươi nặng trĩu. Paris đã thấy được cái gì ở đây?

id: Lantai apa ini? Tiba-tiba melihat ke luar, jembatan yang dulunya besar kini jadi terlihat kecil. Puncak sudah dekat, bersiaplah dan tetap maju.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_774_DESCRIPTION
desc: What floor is this? Suddenly looking outside, the once massive bridge now looks relatively small. The top is near, prepare yourself and move forth.

raw.en: What floor is this? Suddenly looking outside, the once massive bridge now looks relatively small. The top is near, prepare yourself and move forth.
raw.es: ¿Qué piso es este? Cuando miras hacia afuera, el puente que antes era gigante ahora se ve relativamente pequeño. La cima está cerca. Prepárate y avanza.
raw.id: Lantai apa ini? Tiba-tiba melihat ke luar, jembatan yang dulunya besar kini jadi terlihat kecil. Puncak sudah dekat, bersiaplah dan tetap maju.
raw.pt: Que andar é esse? Olhando para fora, agora a ponte antes enorme parece relativamente pequena. O topo está próximo, prepare-se e siga em frente.
raw.th: นี่มันชั้นไหนกันแล้วนะ? ทันใดนั้นเมื่อคุณมองออกไปข้างนอก สะพานที่เคยใหญ่มากในสายตา กลับดูเล็กเสียเหลือเกินในตอนนี้ ชั้นบนสุดอยู่ไม่ไกลแล้ว เตรียมตัวเองไว้ให้ดีและก้าวต่อไปข้างหน้า
raw.vi: Đây là tầng tháp gì? Đột nhiên nhìn ra bên ngoài, cây cầu lớn lúc nãy giờ đây trông thật nhỏ. Đỉnh tháp đã gần kề, hãy tự chuẩn bị và di chuyển lên.

id: Ini mungkin lantai terakhir. Tapi kehadiran Empat Pahlawan datang dari balik pintu menuju atap. Kalahkan mereka dahulu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_775_DESCRIPTION
desc: This could be the final floor. However, you feel the presence of the Four Heroes coming from behind the door leading to the roof. You must defeat them to advance.

raw.en: This could be the final floor. However, you feel the presence of the Four Heroes coming from behind the door leading to the roof. You must defeat them to advance.
raw.es: Este podría ser el piso final. Sin embargo, sientes la presencia de Cuatro héroes que se acercan detrás de la puerta que lleva hacia el techo. Para avanzar, tienes que acabar con ellos.
raw.id: Ini mungkin lantai terakhir. Tapi kehadiran Empat Pahlawan datang dari balik pintu menuju atap. Kalahkan mereka dahulu.
raw.pt: Esse pode ser o último andar. Porém, você sente a presença dos Quatro Heróis atrás da porta que leva ao telhado. Você deve derrotá-los para continuar.
raw.th: นี่อาจจะเป็นชั้นบนสุดแล้ว อย่างไรก็ตามคุณรู้สึกได้ถึงสัมผัสของสี่ผู้กล้ามาจากด้านหลังประตูที่มุ่งหน้าไปสู่หลังคา คุณต้องเอาชนะพวกนั้นเพื่อเดินหน้าต่อไป
raw.vi: Đây có thể là tầng tháp cuối cùng. Tuy nhiên, ngươi cảm thấy có sự hiện diện của Bốn Anh hùng đến từ đằng sau cánh cửa dẫn lên mái nhà. Ngươi phải đánh bại họ để tiến về trước.

id: Ada suara mengerikan dari atap. Gerbang akhir yang melindungi kekuatan tersembunyi Lizeria. Kumpulkan keberanianmu dan maju.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_776_DESCRIPTION
desc: You can hear a ghastly noise coming from the roof. It's the final gate protecting Lizeria's hidden power. Muster your courage and go forth.

raw.en: You can hear a ghastly noise coming from the roof. It's the final gate protecting Lizeria's hidden power. Muster your courage and go forth.
raw.es: Puedes oír un espantoso sonido en el techo. Es la puerta final que protege el poder oculto de Lizeria. Ármate de valor y avanza.
raw.id: Ada suara mengerikan dari atap. Gerbang akhir yang melindungi kekuatan tersembunyi Lizeria. Kumpulkan keberanianmu dan maju.
raw.pt: Você pode ouvir um barulho pavoroso vindo do telhado. É o portão final que protege o poder oculto de Lizeria. Reúna sua coragem e siga em frente.
raw.th: คุณสามารถได้ยินเสียงที่น่ากลัวมาจากหลังคา มันคือประตูสุดท้ายที่คุ้มกันพลังซึ่งหลบซ่อนอยู่ของลิเซอเรีย จงรวบรวมความกล้าของคุณและมุ่งหน้าต่อไป
raw.vi: Ngươi có thể nghe thấy một tiếng ồn khủng khiếp phát ra từ mái nhà. Đó là cảnh cổng cuối cùng bảo vệ sức mạnh ẩn chứa của Lizeria. Hãy can đảm lên và dấn bước.

id: Energi besar keluar dari dalam danau. Tapi untuk apa ia terus meradiasi permukaan?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_780_DESCRIPTION
desc: You can feel the immense energy coming from the depths of the lake. But for what purpose does it continue to radiate the surface?

raw.en: You can feel the immense energy coming from the depths of the lake. But for what purpose does it continue to radiate the surface?
raw.es: Puedes sentir la inmensa cantidad de energía desde la profundidad del lago. ¿Pero con qué propósito continúa radiando en la superficie?
raw.id: Energi besar keluar dari dalam danau. Tapi untuk apa ia terus meradiasi permukaan?
raw.pt: Você pode sentir a energia imensa que vem das profundezas do lago. Mas por qual razão ela continua a irradiar na superfície?
raw.th: คุณสามารถสัมผัสได้ถึงพลังที่รุนแรงมาจากส่วนลึกของทะเลสาบ แต่มันแผ่ขึ้นมาที่พื้นผิวเพื่อจุดประสงค์ใดกัน?
raw.vi: Ngươi có thể cảm thấy năng lượng to lớn đang đến từ sâu dưới đáy hồ. Nhưng vì mục đích gì mà chúng lại lan tỏa trên mặt hồ?

id: Kabut tebal melayang dan cahaya berbau telur busuk menguar di udara. Berhati-hatilah, semua akan tamt begitu kau jatuh ke lubang asal aliran uap.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_800_DESCRIPTION
desc: A thick fog hangs around you as the light stench of rotten eggs fills the air. Be careful as it would all be over if you fell in the hole from which the steam pours.

raw.en: A thick fog hangs around you as the light stench of rotten eggs fills the air. Be careful as it would all be over if you fell in the hole from which the steam pours.
raw.es: Te rodea una espesa niebla, y el aire está infectado con el olor de huevos podridos. Ten cuidado y no caigas en el agujero del que sale el hedor, porque sería el final.
raw.id: Kabut tebal melayang dan cahaya berbau telur busuk menguar di udara. Berhati-hatilah, semua akan tamt begitu kau jatuh ke lubang asal aliran uap.
raw.pt: Uma fumaça espessa empesta o ar à sua volta, com um cheiro de ovos podres. Tome cuidado, pois se você cair no buraco de onde sai o vapor, não tem volta.
raw.th: หมอกหนาอยู่รอบตัวคุณ ขณะที่มีกลิ่นไข่เน่าลอยอยู่เต็มอากาศ ระวังตัวให้ดี เพราะมันอาจจะเป็นจุดจบหากคุณเผลอตกลงไปในรูที่มีไอน้ำพุ่งออกมา
raw.vi: Một đám sương mù dày đặc lơ lửng quanh ngươi trong khi phảng phất mùi hôi trứng thối lan tỏa không gian. Hãy cẩn thận bởi tất cả sẽ kết thúc nếu ngươi rơi vào cái lỗ mà từ đó làn hơi đổ ra.

id: Seperti mandi uap di sini, uap panas membuat sesak napas. Susah memakai zirah berjalan melalui tempat seperti ini.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_801_DESCRIPTION
desc: It's like a steam bath here, the hot steam making it hard to breathe. It'd be difficult to wear armor travelling through a place like this.

raw.en: It's like a steam bath here, the hot steam making it hard to breathe. It'd be difficult to wear armor travelling through a place like this.
raw.es: Este lugar parece una sauna. El vapor caliente dificulta la respiración. Sería difícil usar una armadura y atravesar un lugar como este.
raw.id: Seperti mandi uap di sini, uap panas membuat sesak napas. Susah memakai zirah berjalan melalui tempat seperti ini.
raw.pt: É como um banho de vapor aqui, o vapor quente torna a respiração difícil. É difícil vestir uma armadura enquanto se viaja por um lugar assim.
raw.th: มันเหมือนกับไปอาบไอน้ำเลย ไอร้อนทำให้ยากที่จะหายใจ มันคงเป็นการยากที่จะสวมเกราะแล้วเดินทางผ่านสถานที่แบบนี้
raw.vi: Giống như phòng tắm hơi nơi đây, hơi nước nóng sẽ làm ngươi khó thở. Cũng rất khó khăn khi phải mặc áo giáp đi xuyên qua một nơi như thế này.

id: Panas. Air dingin pasti enak, tapi di sini hanya ada air mendidih. Kau basah kuyup oleh keringat, sekalian mandi di sini.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_802_DESCRIPTION
desc: It's hot. Some cold water would be nice, but there's nothing here but boiling water. You're drenched in sweat, might as well wash off while you're here.

raw.en: It's hot. Some cold water would be nice, but there's nothing here but boiling water. You're drenched in sweat, might as well wash off while you're here.
raw.es: Hace mucho calor. Un poco de agua fresca sería una bendición, pero aquí solo hay agua hirviendo. Sudas como nunca. Tal vez te podrías bañar mientras estás aquí.
raw.id: Panas. Air dingin pasti enak, tapi di sini hanya ada air mendidih. Kau basah kuyup oleh keringat, sekalian mandi di sini.
raw.pt: Está quente. Uma água gelada seria bom, mas aqui não há nada além de água fervente. O suor cobre sua fronte, então ao menos dá para se lavar um pouco enquanto está por aqui.
raw.th: มันร้อน มีน้ำเย็นสักหน่อยก็คงดี แต่ที่นี่ไม่มีอย่างอื่นเลยนอกจากน้ำเดือด คุณท่วมไปด้วยเหงื่อจนแทบจะอาบได้เลยตอนนี้
raw.vi: Nóng quá. Nước lạnh chắc là sẽ tốt hơn, nhưng chẳng có gì ở đây ngoài nước sôi sùng sục. Người ướt đẫm mồ hôi, ngươi cũng có thể rửa người khi đang ở đây.

id: Selain udara penuh uap, bertiuplah angin panas. Udara panas langsung mengeringkan badanmu yang tadinya basah oleh keringat.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_803_DESCRIPTION
desc: Pushing aside the steamy air, a scorching hot wind blows in. The parched air instantly dries your once sweat covered body.

raw.en: Pushing aside the steamy air, a scorching hot wind blows in. The parched air instantly dries your once sweat covered body.
raw.es: Una corriente de viento cálido empuja el vapor del aire. El aire seca instantáneamente tu cuerpo cubierto en sudor.
raw.id: Selain udara penuh uap, bertiuplah angin panas. Udara panas langsung mengeringkan badanmu yang tadinya basah oleh keringat.
raw.pt: Um vento abrasador ainda mais quente empurra o ar escaldante e cheio de vapor. O ar ressequido instantaneamente seca o seu corpo antes tomado de suor.
raw.th: เมื่อไอน้ำในอากาศหมดไป ลมร้อนก็เข้ามาแทน ลมแผดเผาทำให้เหงื่อที่ชุ่มตัวคุณแห้งในทันที
raw.vi: Đẩy luồng hơi sang một bên, một cơn gió nóng thiêu đốt thổi ập đến. Không khí nứt nẻ ngay lập tức sẽ sấy khô mồ hôi bao phủ cơ thể ngươi.

id: Angin bertiup dari arah luar. Rasanya menyegarkan. Namun kau merasa sangat haus dari arah bertiupnya angin. Sepertinya musuh yang kuat.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_804_DESCRIPTION
desc: A wind blows in from outside. It's fresh feel invigorates you. However, you sense a powerful thirst coming from where the wind is blowing. It's likely a strong foe.

raw.en: A wind blows in from outside. It's fresh feel invigorates you. However, you sense a powerful thirst coming from where the wind is blowing. It's likely a strong foe.
raw.es: Una ráfaga de viento entra desde afuera. La frescura te revitaliza. Sin embargo, sientes una presencia poderosa que se acerca desde donde el viento sopla. Sin dudas, es un enemigo poderoso.
raw.id: Angin bertiup dari arah luar. Rasanya menyegarkan. Namun kau merasa sangat haus dari arah bertiupnya angin. Sepertinya musuh yang kuat.
raw.pt: Um vento sopra do exterior. Seu frescor é reinvigorante. Porém, dá para sentir uma poderosa sede que vem da mesma direção que o vento. É provável que seja um inimigo poderoso.
raw.th: ลมพัดเข้ามาจากข้างนอก ความสดชื่นของมันทำให้คุณกระปี้กระเปร่า อย่างไรก็ตาม คุณสัมผัสได้ถึงความกระหายอย่างรุนแรงมาจากทิศทางที่ลมพัดมา มันดูท่าทางจะเป็นศัตรูที่แข็งแกร่ง
raw.vi: Một cơn gió thổi vào từ bên ngoài. Cảm giác tươi mát của làn gió tiếp thêm sinh lực cho ngươi. Tuy nhiên, ngươi cảm nhận được khao khát mạnh mẽ đến từ nơi làn gió đang thổi. Rất có thể là một kẻ thù mạnh mẽ.

id: Semua yang bisa dilihat bervariasi dari uap ke salju, badanmu yang tadi kepanasan langsung dingin. Mengkhawatirkan Karl, kau terus mengejarnya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_810_DESCRIPTION
desc: All you see goes from steam to snow, and your once steaming hot body is instantly cooled. Worried about Karl, you continue after him.

raw.en: All you see goes from steam to snow, and your once steaming hot body is instantly cooled. Worried about Karl, you continue after him.
raw.es: Todo lo que era vapor se convierte en nieve, y tu cuerpo, que antes estaba hirviendo, se enfría instantáneamente. Te preocupa Karl, y continúas buscándolo.
raw.id: Semua yang bisa dilihat bervariasi dari uap ke salju, badanmu yang tadi kepanasan langsung dingin. Mengkhawatirkan Karl, kau terus mengejarnya.
raw.pt: Tudo que você vê passa do vapor à neve, e o seu antes esfumaçante corpo quente é instantaneamente resfriado. Por preocupação com Karl, você continua atrás dele.
raw.th: ทุกอย่างที่คุณเห็นเปลี่ยนจากไอน้ำเป็นหิมะ และร่างกายที่เคยร้อนระอุก็กลับเย็นลงในทันที ด้วยความเป็นห่วงคาร์ล คุณไล่ตามเพื่อช่วยเขาต่อไป
raw.vi: Tất cả những gì ngươi thấy chuyển từ hơi nước thành tuyết trắng, và cơ thể nóng hổi qua hơi nước của ngươi sẽ mát dịu ngay lập tức. Vẫn lo lắng cho Karl, ngươi tiếp tục tìm hắn.

id: Sebelum kau sadar, rambut dan bajumu yang tadi basah, kini beku. Pasti masuk angin dengan cuaca seperti ini. Singkirkan es beku dan bergegaslah.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_811_DESCRIPTION
desc: Before you notice, your once wet hair and clothes are frozen. Surely you'll catch a cold in this radically changing weather. Brush away the frost and hurry ahead.

raw.en: Before you notice, your once wet hair and clothes are frozen. Surely you'll catch a cold in this radically changing weather. Brush away the frost and hurry ahead.
raw.es: Antes de que te des cuenta, el pelo y el atuendo mojadas ahora están congelados. En este clima tan cambiante, es imposible no resfriarse. Hazle frente al frio y continúa en tu búsqueda.
raw.id: Sebelum kau sadar, rambut dan bajumu yang tadi basah, kini beku. Pasti masuk angin dengan cuaca seperti ini. Singkirkan es beku dan bergegaslah.
raw.pt: Antes que pudesse notar, seu cabelo e roupas, antes molhados, congelaram. Certamente você vai pegar um resfriado nesse clima de extremos. Livre-se do gelo e continue adiante.
raw.th: ก่อนที่คุณจะรู้ตัว ผมกับเสื้อที่เคยเปียกของคุณก็ถูกแช่แข็ง คุณจะต้องเป็นหวัดแน่นอนกับอากาศที่เปลี่ยนอย่างกระทันหันเช่นนี้ สะบัดน้ำแข็งทิ้งและรีบเดินหน้าต่อไป
raw.vi: Trước khi ngươi nhận ra, cả tóc tai và quần áo ướt đẫm của ngươi đã bị đông cứng. Chắc chắn ngươi sẽ bị cảm lạnh trong thời tiết thay đổi bất ngờ này. Phủi đi những băng giá và tiến nhanh về phía trước.

id: Pemandangan bersalju di hadapanmu cantik, tapi sekarang bukan saatnya untuk menikmati. Harus mengejar Karl.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_812_DESCRIPTION
desc: The sprawling snowscape before you is gorgeous, but as much as you'd like to stare this isn't the time to get distracted. You must catch up to Karl.

raw.en: The sprawling snowscape before you is gorgeous, but as much as you'd like to stare this isn't the time to get distracted. You must catch up to Karl.
raw.es: Te encantaría disfrutar del hermoso paisaje nevado que tienes delante de ti, pero no hay tiempo para distraerse. Tienes que alcanzar a Karl.
raw.id: Pemandangan bersalju di hadapanmu cantik, tapi sekarang bukan saatnya untuk menikmati. Harus mengejar Karl.
raw.pt: A paisagem nevada à sua frente é linda, mas por mais que adoraria ficar olhando para ela, você não tem tempo para se distrair. Você precisa alcançar o Karl.
raw.th: ดินแดนหิมะทอดยาวข้างหน้าคุณช่างดูสวยงาม ถึงคุณจะชอบมองดูมันแค่ไหนแต่นี่ก็ไม่ใช่เวลาจะมาสนใจเรื่องอื่น คุณจะต้องตามคาร์ลให้ทัน
raw.vi: Cảnh tuyết phủ rực rỡ trước mặt ngươi thật tuyệt, nhưng dù ngươi có muốn chăm chú nhìn thì đây cũng không phải lúc để phân tâm. Ngươi phải bắt kịp Karl.

id: Salju yang perlahan jatuh mulai menutupi jejak Karl. Harus cepat menemukan dia sebelum kehilangan semua jejak.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_813_DESCRIPTION
desc: You notice that the softly falling snow is starting to cover Karl's tracks. You must find him before you lose trace of him.

raw.en: You notice that the softly falling snow is starting to cover Karl's tracks. You must find him before you lose trace of him.
raw.es: Te das cuenta de que la nieve que cae comienza a cubrir las huellas de Karl. Tienes que encontrarlo antes de que pierdas su rastro.
raw.id: Salju yang perlahan jatuh mulai menutupi jejak Karl. Harus cepat menemukan dia sebelum kehilangan semua jejak.
raw.pt: Você nota que a neve que cai suavemente está começando a cobrir os rastros do Karl. Você precisa encontrá-lo antes de perder o rastro.
raw.th: คุณเริ่มสังเกตเห็นว่าหิมะที่โปรยปรายเริ่มกลบเส้นทางเดินของคาร์ล คุณจะต้องหาเขาให้เจอก่อนที่จะสูญเสียร่องรอยไป
raw.vi: Ngươi thấy rằng tuyết rơi nhẹ nhàng đang bắt đầu xóa dấu vết của Karl. Ngươi phải tìm thấy anh ta trước khi mất dấu.

id: Berjalan melalui lanskap putih, suara tegas dan dingin mengejutkanmu. Gema tembakan ada di depan!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_814_DESCRIPTION
desc: As you traverse the whitewashed landscape, you're surprised by a firm, icy sound. It's the echo of icy gunfire headed your way!

raw.en: As you traverse the whitewashed landscape, you're surprised by a firm, icy sound. It's the echo of icy gunfire headed your way!
raw.es: Mientras atraviesas el blanco paisaje, un sonido firme y glacial te toma por sorpresa. ¡Es el eco de disparos gélidos que se aproximan!
raw.id: Berjalan melalui lanskap putih, suara tegas dan dingin mengejutkanmu. Gema tembakan ada di depan!
raw.pt: À medida que viaja pela paisagem branca, você se surpreende com um som firme e frio. São os ecos de disparos gélidos vindo na sua direção!
raw.th: ขณะที่คุณสำรวจภูมิทัศน์สีขาวอยู่นั้น คุณก็ต้องประหลาดใจกับเสียงน้ำแข็งดังแน่น มันเป็นเสียงสะท้อนของปืนน้ำแข็งมุ่งหน้าไปยังทางของคุณ
raw.vi: Khi đi qua vùng đất tuyết phủ trắng xóa, ngươi bỗng giật mình bởi một âm thanh sắc lạnh, băng giá. Đó là âm vọng của tiếng súng theo hướng ngươi đi!

id: Banyak tumbuhan yang tidak pernah kamu lihat sebelumnya. Tebas mereka agar kamu bisa maju, seperti yang diharapkan oleh Seria.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_820_DESCRIPTION
desc: Plants that you've never seen before flourish everywhere. Smash your way through this overflowingly vibrant forest just as Seria would expect you to.

raw.en: Plants that you've never seen before flourish everywhere. Smash your way through this overflowingly vibrant forest just as Seria would expect you to.
raw.es: Plantas que jamás has visto florecen por todas partes. Aplasta todo lo que encuentres a tu paso y atraviesa este exuberante bosque como Seria te lo hubiera indicado.
raw.id: Banyak tumbuhan yang tidak pernah kamu lihat sebelumnya. Tebas mereka agar kamu bisa maju, seperti yang diharapkan oleh Seria.
raw.pt: Plantas que você nunca viu antes florescem por todo lado. Abra caminho por essa florest vibrante, exatamente do jeito que a Seria esperaria.
raw.th: พืชที่คุณไม่เคยเห็นมาก่อนเติบโตอยู่ทุกที่ บุกป่าฝ่าดงแห่งนี้ไปให้เหมือนกับที่ซีเรียคาดหวังว่าคุณจะทำ
raw.vi: Những loài cây ngươi chưa bao giờ thấy qua đang đâm chồi khắp mọi nơi. Hãy theo con đường của ngươi băng qua cánh rừng đầy sôi động này bởi Seria cũng mong chờ ngươi như vậy.

id: Hutan gelap ini panas dan lembab. Tidak sepanas di gua penuh uap tadi, tapi kamu mulai berkeringat.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_821_DESCRIPTION
desc: It's hot and humid in this dark forest. It's not as hot here as it was in that steamy cavern, but you're already beginning to sweat.

raw.en: It's hot and humid in this dark forest. It's not as hot here as it was in that steamy cavern, but you're already beginning to sweat.
raw.es: Este bosque oscuro es muy cálido y húmedo. No hace tanto calor como en aquella caverna llena de vapor, pero ya estás empezando a sudar.
raw.id: Hutan gelap ini panas dan lembab. Tidak sepanas di gua penuh uap tadi, tapi kamu mulai berkeringat.
raw.pt: Essa floresta além de escura, é quente e úmida. Pode não ser tão quente quanto naquela caverna que mais parecia uma sauna, mas é o suficiente para fazer você suar.
raw.th: มันทั้งร้อนและชื้นมากในป่าที่มืดมิดแห่งนี้ แม้จะไม่ร้อนเท่ากับถ้ำที่เต็มไปด้วยไอน้ำก่อนหน้านี้ แต่คุณก็เริ่มจะเหงื่อไหลแล้ว
raw.vi: Trời nóng và ẩm ướt trong khu rừng tối tăm này. Ở đây không phải nóng như trong chỗ hang động đầy hơi nước kia, nhưng ngươi cũng đã bắt đầu đổ mồ hôi.

id: Banyak bunga aneh yang mekar dengan bangga di sekitarmu. Campuran bau mereka menebarkan aroma yang aneh. Seperti… memabukkan…
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_822_DESCRIPTION
desc: Various strange flowers bloom proudly around you. Their mixing smells produce a strange aroma. It's almost...intoxicating...

raw.en: Various strange flowers bloom proudly around you. Their mixing smells produce a strange aroma. It's almost...intoxicating...
raw.es: Alrededor de ti brotan varias flores extrañas. La mezcla de olores produce un aroma extraño. Es casi... embriagador...
raw.id: Banyak bunga aneh yang mekar dengan bangga di sekitarmu. Campuran bau mereka menebarkan aroma yang aneh. Seperti… memabukkan…
raw.pt: Várias flores estranhas brotam com orgulho ao seu redor. Os aromas misturados produzem um aroma estranho. É quase... intoxicante...
raw.th: ดอกไม้ประหลาดหลายชนิดเบ่งบานอยู่รอบตัวคุณ กลิ่นที่ปนเปของมันสร้างกลิ่นหอมหวนแปลกๆ มันคล้ายๆ กับ.... จะทำให้มึนเมา......
raw.vi: Muôn hoa kỳ lạ đang nở rộ khoe sắc quanh ngươi. Mùi hương chúng trộn lẫn mang lại một hương thơm kỳ lạ. Nó gần như là...say nghiện...

id: Dari kejauhan kamu melihat sebuah pohon besar, tapi sekarang sepertinya pohon itu menuju ke arahmu. Apakah ini ilusi, atau pohon itu memang bergerak?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_823_DESCRIPTION
desc: From far away you thought you saw a large tree, but now it seems to be coming toward you. Is this an illusion, or is the tree really moving?

raw.en: From far away you thought you saw a large tree, but now it seems to be coming toward you. Is this an illusion, or is the tree really moving?
raw.es: Desde lejos, creíste ver un árbol que se movía. Ahora, parece que el árbol viene hacia ti. ¿Es una ilusión o el árbol se está moviendo realmente?
raw.id: Dari kejauhan kamu melihat sebuah pohon besar, tapi sekarang sepertinya pohon itu menuju ke arahmu. Apakah ini ilusi, atau pohon itu memang bergerak?
raw.pt: De longe você achou que tinha visto uma árvore enorme, mas agora parece que ela está vindo na sua direção. É uma ilusão, ou ela realmente está se movendo?
raw.th: จากระยะไกลๆ คุณคิดว่าคุณมองเห็นต้นไม้ใหญ่ แต่ตอนนี้ดูเหมือนว่ามันกำลังมุ่งหน้ามาหาคุณ มันจะเป็นแค่ภาพลวงตาหรือว่าต้นไม้นี้มันเคลื่อนที่ได้จริงๆ ?
raw.vi: Từ xa ngươi nghĩ rằng đã nhìn thấy một cái cây lớn, nhưng lúc này dường như nó đang tiến đến phía ngươi. Đây có phải là ảo tưởng, hay là cây thực sự biết đi?

id: Ketika sinar matahari mulai terlihat, sepertinya kamu akan segera lolos. Karl dan Seria ada di reruntuhan setelah ini. Kamu harus secepatnya ke sana.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_824_DESCRIPTION
desc: As sunlight begins to peek into the forest, it seems you might be able to get out. Karl and Seria are in the ruins ahead. You must hurry to them.

raw.en: As sunlight begins to peek into the forest, it seems you might be able to get out. Karl and Seria are in the ruins ahead. You must hurry to them.
raw.es: Mientras la luz se filtra en el bosque, crees que estás cerca de poder escapar. Karl y Seria se encuentran en las ruinas que están más adelante. Tienes que apurarte y alcanzarlos.
raw.id: Ketika sinar matahari mulai terlihat, sepertinya kamu akan segera lolos. Karl dan Seria ada di reruntuhan setelah ini. Kamu harus secepatnya ke sana.
raw.pt: Conforme a luz do sol começa a se infiltrar na floresta, parece que você vai conseguir sair. Karl e Seria estão nas ruínas adiante. É melhor se apressar até eles.
raw.th: แสงอาทิตย์เริ่มส่องผ่านเข้ามาในป่า ดูเหมือนว่าคุณอาจจะหาทางออกไปได้ คาร์ลกับซีเรียอยู่ที่ซากโบราณข้างหน้า คุณต้องรีบไปหาพวกเขาโดยเร็ว
raw.vi: Khi ánh sáng mặt trời bắt đầu thưa thớt lọt xuống cánh rừng, có vẻ như ngươi có thể ra khỏi nơi này được. Karl và Seria đang ở nơi tàn tích đổ nát phía trước. Ngươi phải nhanh chóng đến chỗ họ.

id: Kamu harus lari dari reruntuhan dan pergi ke menara di mana Karl ditahan. Tilith bisa merawat Seria, jadi kamu harus secepatnya maju.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_830_DESCRIPTION
desc: You must escape the ruins to get to the tower where Karl is being held. Tilith can take care of Seria, so hurry ahead as fast as you can.

raw.en: You must escape the ruins to get to the tower where Karl is being held. Tilith can take care of Seria, so hurry ahead as fast as you can.
raw.es: Tienes que escapar de las ruinas y llegar a la torre donde Karl está cautivo. Tilith se puede encargar de Seria, así que apresúrate.
raw.id: Kamu harus lari dari reruntuhan dan pergi ke menara di mana Karl ditahan. Tilith bisa merawat Seria, jadi kamu harus secepatnya maju.
raw.pt: Você deve fugir das ruínas para chegar à torre onde o Karl está preso. Tilith pode tomar conta de Seria, então vá o mais depressa que puder.
raw.th: คุณจะต้องหลบหนีจากซากโบราณเพื่อไปให้ถึงหอคอยที่คาร์ลถูกคุมตัวอยู่ ทิลิธสามารถดูแลซีเรียได้ ฉะนั้นคุณต้องล่วงหน้าไปให้เร็วที่สุดเท่าที่ทำได้
raw.vi: Ngươi phải thoát khỏi đống đổ nát đó để đến được ngọn tháp nơi Karl bị giam giữ. Tilith có thể lo cho Seria, do đó, hãy tiến về trước nhanh nhất có thể.

id: Puingnya sudah tua, tapi sihir masih menyelubungi area. Yang aneh, itu bukan api tapi kekuatan sihir guntur yang digunakan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_831_DESCRIPTION
desc: The ruins are quite old, but magic still illuminates the area. What's strange, however, is that it isn't fire, but the power of thunder magic which is being used.

raw.en: The ruins are quite old, but magic still illuminates the area. What's strange, however, is that it isn't fire, but the power of thunder magic which is being used.
raw.es: Las ruinas son muy viejas, pero la magia todavía ilumina el área. Lo que es extraño, sin embargo, es que no están usando fuego, sino el poder de la magia atronadora.
raw.id: Puingnya sudah tua, tapi sihir masih menyelubungi area. Yang aneh, itu bukan api tapi kekuatan sihir guntur yang digunakan.
raw.pt: As ruínas são bem velhas, mas a magia ainda ilumina a área. No entando, o que é estranho é que não é o fogo, mas sim o poder da magia do trovão que está sendo usado.
raw.th: ซากโบราณค่อยข้างเก่าแก่ แต่สิ่งมหัศจรรย์ยังคงส่องสว่างในพื้นที่ สิ่งที่แปลกก็คือว่ามันไม่ใช่ไฟ แต่เป็นอำนาจของเวทมนตร์สายฟ้าที่ถูกใช้
raw.vi: Những tàn tích đã cũ kỹ, nhưng ma thuật vẫn chiếu sáng cả vùng. Tuy nhiên, thật kỳ lạ đó không phải là lửa mà là sức mạnh của ma thuật sấm sét đang được sử dụng.

id: Meski bagian luar reruntuhan itu kasar, bentuknya masih utuh. Sepertinya juga tidak ada jebakan untuk melindunginya dari penyusup, tapi...
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_832_DESCRIPTION
desc: As rough as the inside of the ruins is, they still seem to be intact. There also don't appear to be any traps to protect from intruders, but still...

raw.en: As rough as the inside of the ruins is, they still seem to be intact. There also don't appear to be any traps to protect from intruders, but still...
raw.es: Si bien las ruinas son bastante ásperas, parecen estar intactas. También te percatas de que no parece haber trampas contra los intrusos, aunque...
raw.id: Meski bagian luar reruntuhan itu kasar, bentuknya masih utuh. Sepertinya juga tidak ada jebakan untuk melindunginya dari penyusup, tapi...
raw.pt: Por mais toscas que sejam as entranhas da ruína, parece que elas estão intactas. Também não parecem ter armadilhas protegendo contra intrusos, mas ainda assim...
raw.th: แม้ว่าภายในซากโบราณจะเละเทะแค่ไหน แต่มันก็ยังดูสมบูรณ์อยู่ และก็ยังดูเหมือนว่าจะไม่มีกับดักที่วางไว้ป้องกันผู้บุกรุก แต่มันก็ยัง...
raw.vi: Vẫn thô ráp như bên trong đống đổ nát, chúng dường như vẫn còn nguyên vẹn. Cũng không thấy bất cứ cái bẫy nào để bảo vệ khỏi kẻ xâm nhập, nhưng dù sao...

id: Sepertinya puing ini tadinya dipakai sebagai benteng. Ada gudang senjata penuh tombak, meski sudah berkarat.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_833_DESCRIPTION
desc: It seems these ruins were once used as a fortress. There are armories lined with spears, though each one of them is covered with rust.

raw.en: It seems these ruins were once used as a fortress. There are armories lined with spears, though each one of them is covered with rust.
raw.es: Parece que estas ruinas antaño fueron una fortaleza. Hay armerías atiborradas de lanzas, aunque todas ellas están oxidadas.
raw.id: Sepertinya puing ini tadinya dipakai sebagai benteng. Ada gudang senjata penuh tombak, meski sudah berkarat.
raw.pt: Parece que essas ruínas costumavam ser usadas como fortaleza. Há arsenais lotados de lanças, apesar de cada uma delas estar coberta de ferrugem.
raw.th: ดูเหมือนว่าที่แห่งนี้เคยเป็นป้อมปราการ มีชุดเกราะตั้งเรียงรายอยู่พร้อมกับหอก แต่ตอนนี้พวกมันทุกอันนั้นเต็มไปด้วยสนิมจับ
raw.vi: Có vẻ như những tàn tích này đã từng được dùng làm pháo đài. Có cả kho vũ khí đầy những giáo, thương, mặc dù mọi thứ đều đã hoen rỉ.

id: Musuh kuat ada di dekat pintu keluar puing. Murid Zevalhua, Mare, mampu membaca pergerakan Seria saat menyerangnya. Berhati-hatilah.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_834_DESCRIPTION
desc: You sense a strong enemy near the exit to the ruins. Zevalhua's disciple Mare was able to read Seria's movements in attacking her. Be careful.

raw.en: You sense a strong enemy near the exit to the ruins. Zevalhua's disciple Mare was able to read Seria's movements in attacking her. Be careful.
raw.es: Percibes a un enemigo poderoso cerca de la salida de las ruinas. Mare, la discípula de Zevalhua, pudo leer los movimientos de Seria para contraatacarla. Ten cuidado.
raw.id: Musuh kuat ada di dekat pintu keluar puing. Murid Zevalhua, Mare, mampu membaca pergerakan Seria saat menyerangnya. Berhati-hatilah.
raw.pt: Você sente um inimigo poderoso perto da saída das ruínas. Mare, discípula de Zevalhua, conseguiu ler os movimentos de Seria ao atacá-la. Tome cuidado.
raw.th: คุณสัมผัสได้ถึงศัตรูที่แข็งแกร่งใกล้ๆ กับทางออกของซากโบราณ แมร์ สาวกของเซวาลฮัวสามารถอ่านการโจมตีของซีเรียได้ ระวังไว้ให้ดี
raw.vi: Ngươi linh cảm thấy có một kẻ thù mạnh mẽ gần lối ra vào tàn tích. Mare, đệ tử của Zevalhua, đã có thể đọc được chuyển động của Seria khi tấn công ả. Hãy cẩn thận.

id: Angin bertiuo dengna lembut menembus sinar lembut matahari. Keluar puing, kamu tiba di sisi pegunungan. Langit jernih, cuaca menyenangkan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_840_DESCRIPTION
desc: A wind gently blows through the soft sunlight. Exiting the ruins, you seem to be on the side of a mountain. The sky is clear and the weather is pleasant.

raw.en: A wind gently blows through the soft sunlight. Exiting the ruins, you seem to be on the side of a mountain. The sky is clear and the weather is pleasant.
raw.es: Una leve brisa viaja a través de la débil luz solar. Cuando sales de las ruinas, te encuentras en la ladera de una montaña. El cielo está despejado, y el clima es agradable.
raw.id: Angin bertiuo dengna lembut menembus sinar lembut matahari. Keluar puing, kamu tiba di sisi pegunungan. Langit jernih, cuaca menyenangkan.
raw.pt: Um vento sopra gentilmente através da luz suave do sol. Saindo das ruínas, parece que você está na lateral de uma montanha. O céu está límpido e o clima é agradável.
raw.th: ลมอ่อนๆ พัดผ่นแสงแดดนุ่มนวล ออกจากซากโบราณแล้วดูเหมือนว่าคุณจะโผล่มาที่ด้านข้างของภูเขา ท้องฟ้าดูสดใสและอากาศก็ดี
raw.vi: Một cơn gió nhẹ nhàng thổi qua ánh nắng dịu nhạt. Thoát khỏi đống đổ nát, dường như ngươi đang ở bên kia một ngọn núi. Bầu trời trong xanh và thời tiết thật dễ chịu.

id: Apakah jalan ini juga bagian dari puing? Tertutup lumut dan pecahan patung dengan berlalunya waktu. Tidak ada waktu untuk bersantai.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_841_DESCRIPTION
desc: Could this path also be part of the ruins? The moss covered path and crumbling statues show show the passage of time. Still, this is no time to relax.

raw.en: Could this path also be part of the ruins? The moss covered path and crumbling statues show show the passage of time. Still, this is no time to relax.
raw.es: ¿Acaso este camino es parte de las ruinas? El camino cubierto de musgo y las estatuas derruidas dan cuenta de paso del tiempo. No obstante, no es momento de descansar.
raw.id: Apakah jalan ini juga bagian dari puing? Tertutup lumut dan pecahan patung dengan berlalunya waktu. Tidak ada waktu untuk bersantai.
raw.pt: Será que esse caminho também é parte das ruínas? O caminho coberto de musgo e estátuas mostra a passagem do tempo. Mas não há tempo para relaxar.
raw.th: หรือว่าเส้นทางนี้จะเป็นส่วนหนึ่งของซากโบราณ? เส้นทางที่ปกคลุมไปด้วยตะไคร่กับรูปปั้นที่ล้มกระจายแสดงให้เห็นถึงเส้นทางของกาลเวลา ถึงอย่างนั้นนี่ก็ไม่ใช่เวลาที่จะมาหย่อนใจ
raw.vi: Liệu con đường này cũng có thể là một phần của tàn tích? Con đường rêu phủ và những bức tượng đổ nát cho thấy dấu chân thời gian trôi qua. Tuy nhiên, đây không phải là lúc thư giãn.

id: Udaranya segar di sini. Enak untuk berhenti dan menarik napas panjang. Pemandangan sangat indah, mungkin kamu bisa kembali setelah menyelamatkan Karl.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_842_DESCRIPTION
desc: The air is invigorating here. It'd be nice to stop here and take a deep breath. The view is so beautiful, maybe you can return here after Karl is rescued.

raw.en: The air is invigorating here. It'd be nice to stop here and take a deep breath. The view is so beautiful, maybe you can return here after Karl is rescued.
raw.es: Aquí, el aire es revitalizante. Sería fantástico tomarse un momento y respirar aire puro. La vista es preciosa. Tal vez puedas regresar a este lugar cuando rescates a Karl.
raw.id: Udaranya segar di sini. Enak untuk berhenti dan menarik napas panjang. Pemandangan sangat indah, mungkin kamu bisa kembali setelah menyelamatkan Karl.
raw.pt: O ar aqui é revigorante. Seria um bom lugar para descansar e recuperar o fôlego. A vista é bão bonita, que dá vontade de voltar depois de resgatar o Karl.
raw.th: อากาศสดชื่นมากที่นี่ คงจะดีถ้าได้หยุดพักหายใจที่นี่ วิวดูสวยงาม บางทีคุณอาจจะสามารถกลับมาที่นี่หลังจากช่วยเหลือคาร์ลได้แล้ว
raw.vi: Không khí dường như được tiếp thêm sinh lực ở đây. Thật tuyệt khi dừng lại ở đây và hít một hơi thật sâu. Cảnh quan trông rất đẹp, có lẽ ngươi sẽ trở lại đây sau khi Karl được giải cứu.

id: Jalan di pegunungan perlahan menjadi turun. Kamu merasa sedih perjalananmu di gunung yang indah ini akan berakhir, tapi kamu harus cepat maju.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_843_DESCRIPTION
desc: The mountain path slowly turns downhill. As your trip around this beautiful mountain comes to an end you almost feel sad, but you must hurry forward.

raw.en: The mountain path slowly turns downhill. As your trip around this beautiful mountain comes to an end you almost feel sad, but you must hurry forward.
raw.es: El camino de montaña se inclina levemente hacia abajo. Mientras caminas, la bella montaña llega a su fin. Sientes un dejo de tristeza, pero no puedes detenerte.
raw.id: Jalan di pegunungan perlahan menjadi turun. Kamu merasa sedih perjalananmu di gunung yang indah ini akan berakhir, tapi kamu harus cepat maju.
raw.pt: O caminho da montanha desce lentamente. À medida que sua viagem por essa bela montanha chega ao fim, você quase se entristece, mas precisa continuar.
raw.th: เส้นทางภูเขาค่อยๆ เปลี่ยนเป็นลาดลง ขณะที่การเดินทางผ่านภูเขาที่สวยงามนี้ของคุณต้องจบลง คุณก็เกือบที่จะรู้สึกเศร้า แต่คุณก็ต้องรีบมุ่งหน้าต่อไป
raw.vi: Con đường trên núi dần dần thoải xuống dốc. Khi chuyến đi quanh ngọn núi xinh đẹp này đến hồi kết thúc ngươi thấy hơi buồn, nhưng ngươi phải tiến nhanh lên phía trước.

id: Gua terbuka lebar di depanmu. Kamu harusnya bisa mencapai menara melewati gua ini. Kamu harus siap menghadapi serangan tiba-tiba.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_844_DESCRIPTION
desc: The cave is wide open before you. You should be able to get to the tower through here. You'd better prepare yourself for surprise attacks.

raw.en: The cave is wide open before you. You should be able to get to the tower through here. You'd better prepare yourself for surprise attacks.
raw.es: La cueva se abre frente a ti. Deberías poder llegar a la torre desde aquí. Será mejor que te prepares para emboscadas.
raw.id: Gua terbuka lebar di depanmu. Kamu harusnya bisa mencapai menara melewati gua ini. Kamu harus siap menghadapi serangan tiba-tiba.
raw.pt: A caverna se abre à sua frente. Você deve conseguir chegar até a torre por aqui. É melhor você se preparar para ataques surpresa.
raw.th: ถ้ำแห่งนี้เปิดกว้างต้อนรับคุณ คุณน่าจะสามารถผ่านที่นี่ไปยังหอคอยได้ คุณควรจะเตรียมตัวให้พร้อมจากการโจมตีที่ไม่คาดคิด
raw.vi: Hang động đó đang mở rộng trước mặt ngươi. Xuyên qua đây ngươi sẽ có thể đến được tòa tháp. Tốt hơn ngươi nên tự mình chuẩn bị những cuộc tấn công bất ngờ.

id: Memasuki gua dari jalan gunung yang terang, matamu belum beradaptasi. Gua ini cukup gelap, tidak banyak cahaya yang masuk.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_850_DESCRIPTION
desc: Entering the cave from the bright mountain path, your eyes have yet to adjust. Despite the dim light, the cave is considerably dark.

raw.en: Entering the cave from the bright mountain path, your eyes have yet to adjust. Despite the dim light, the cave is considerably dark.
raw.es: Al entrar a las cuevas después de transitar el brillante camino de montaña, notas que los ojos se te tienen que acostumbrar. A pesar de la débil luz, la cueva es considerablemente oscura.
raw.id: Memasuki gua dari jalan gunung yang terang, matamu belum beradaptasi. Gua ini cukup gelap, tidak banyak cahaya yang masuk.
raw.pt: Entrando na caverna pelo caminho iluminado da montanha, seus olhos ainda precisam se ajustar. Mesmo com um pouco de luz, a caverna é consideravelmente escura.
raw.th: เมื่อเข้าไปในถ้ำจากเส้นทางที่สว่างของภูเขา สายตาของคุณยังไม่สามารถปรับได้ทัน แม้จะมีแสงรางๆ แต่ถ้ำนี้ก็ถือว่ามืดมากๆ
